name: Tinker: Clockwork Ingenuity reaches the Tinker's summons
contract: #521: Clockwork Ingenuity (505336) needs no script. Its effect 1 is the fork's SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS, which UnitAura::FillTargetMap delivers to every summon the caster controls on the same map, carrying SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_HEALTH_PERCENT with amount 10. A Mechano-Bear that is already out must gain the aura when the passive is learned and lose it when it is unlearned, and the amount the summons receive must stay 10.

steps.label: Without the passive the summon carries no Clockwork Ingenuity aura
The summon aura reaches the existing Mechano-Bear
Exactly one owned Mechano-Bear carries it
The maximum-health bonus the summons receive is 10%
Unlearning takes the aura off the summon
